cd /tmp && cat > tz2.py <<'EOF'
import sys, io, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd
d = zstd.ZstdDecompressor()
data=b'hello world,'*100
frame = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(data)
r = d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(frame))
print('read big', len(r.read(100000)))
r = d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(frame))
print('read default', len(r.read()))
# checksum
fr2 = zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True).compress(b'abc'*10)
print('ck frame', fr2[:6].hex(), len(fr2))
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(fr2))
try:
    print('ck read', r.read(1000))
except Exception as e:
    print('ck err', type(e).__name__, e)
bad = bytearray(fr2); bad[-1]^=0xff
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(bytes(bad)))
try:
    print('badck', r.read(1000))
except Exception as e:
    print('badck err', type(e).__name__, e)
# corrupt block content
fr4 = bytearray(zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(b'abc'*1000))
fr4[10]^=0xff
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(bytes(fr4)))
try:
    print('badblock', r.read(100000))
except Exception as e:
    print('badblock err', type(e).__name__, e)
# unknown content size
c3 = zstd.ZstdCompressor(zstd.ZstdCompressionParameters.from_level(3, write_content_size=False))
fr3 = c3.compress(b'xyz'*1000)
print('fr3 hdr', fr3[:6].hex())
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(fr3))
print('unknown size read', len(r.read(100000)))
try:
    print('decompress()', len(d.decompress(fr3)))
except Exception as e:
    print('decompress err', type(e).__name__, e)
# empty frame (empty content)
fre = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(b'')
print('empty frame', fre[:8].hex(), len(fre))
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(fre))
print('empty read', r.read(100))
# empty input
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(b''))
print('noinput read', r.read(100))
EOF
